newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Central Bank cut discount rate to 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Central Bank cut discount rate to 13 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Egypt has cut its largelyt indicative discount rate for the second time in less than one month to 13.00 percent from 13.25 percent, a Central Bank official said on Monday.

The official told Reuters the cut, effective from December 5, followed lower interest rates on 91-day treasury bills, the benchmark for the discount rate. Rates have been steadily declining since November with interest rates on 91-day bills falling at last auction to 10.140 percent from 10.153 percent.
"We felt the gap was too big between the two rates," the official said.
On November 21, the Central Bank cut the discount rate to 13.25 from 13.5 percent. It was the first reduction since November 1995.
Bankers said they never borrow at the discount rate, which is merely indicative of the Central Bank's intentions about interest rates in general.
